column2: Swords aren’t the be-all and end-all, you know. I could do fairly well against either of you, I think, if you had a sword and I had my quarterstaff.
Women are like…goats…
You're Aes Sedai. . .I figured you . . . you know, saidared it.
Al dival, al kiserai, al mashi!' For light, glory, and love!
Blood and bloody ashes!
I'm a gambler, a farmboy, and I'm here to take command of your bloody army!
Almost dead yesterday, maybe dead tomorrow, but alive, gloriously alive, today.
Just because a man marries someone doesn't mean he suddenly becomes bloody nobility.
And Matrim Cauthon to bloody even the odds.

We are going to tickle some Aes Sedai under the chin, rescue a mule, and put a snip-nosed girl on the Lion Throne. Oh, yes. That's Aviendha. Don't look at her crosswise, or she'll try to cut your throat and probably slit her own by mistake.
Now. When the poor blind fool they've chosen out for their Amyrlin gets here, I will do the talking. She can't be very bright, or they'd never have been able to shove her into the job…
Bloody ashes, woman. This isn't a metaphor for anything! It's just boots.
Catching badgers… Bloody hard to do, you know, particularly on short notice.
Burn me, if we're going to do this thing, let's do it. Dovie'andi se tovya sagain.

They could put up a warning sign or something. Hello. Welcome to Hinderstap. We will murder you in the night and eat your bloody face if you stay past sunset. Try the pies. Martna Baily makes them fresh daily.
Bloody ashes, Hawkwing! You needn't have drawn it out like that, you bloody goat-kisser. So you fight for us?
Los caba'drin!
I'm right, anyway. I wish I wasn't, but I am. I bloody am.
I may lead you wrong now and then, but in the end, you can be sure that I'm always a safe bet.
I do read sometimes
I may be a fool, but I intend to be a live fool.
We’ll drink the wine till the cup is dry, and kiss the girls so they’ll not cry, and toss the dice until we fly to dance with Jak o’ the Shadows.
We'll dance all night while the moon runs free, and dandle the lasses upon our knee, and then you'll ride along with me, to dance with Jak o' the Shadows.
Blood and ashes. Blood and bloody ashes!
Uncase the banner, Macoll,… This time, we'll let them know who's killing them.
Nothing like a little dance with Trollocs to ready you for sleep. Right, Aviendha?
Both of them?... Light! Two! Oh, burn me! He's the luckiest man in the world or the biggest fool since creation!
I'm a gambler, not a soldier. A lover.
Men teach cats curiosity, but cats keep sense for themselves.
Battles Interest Me
Damodred… P.S. If you see any Trollocs with quarterstaffs, I suggest you let Golever fight them instead, as I know you have trouble with those types.
That is just bloody wonderful.
I'm no lord. I've more respect for myself than that.
She's not a woman, Talmanes,… She's an Aes Sedai. Don't think of her as a woman.
You could put a man's eye out with that thing, and normally I wouldn't mind, but I'm running short on eyes these days.
I beat you, you crusty boot-leavings! I, Matrim Cauthon, survived your traps! Ha!
And you gave me the way out! Chew on that bitterness for lunch, you flaming, burning, misbegotten liars!
For a gleeman, you seem to leave out most of the heroic parts of the things I do… At least you mentioned the hat.
Oh, sheep swallop! Sheep swallop and bloody buttered onions!
No,… I mean, yes. I mean. . . . That is. . . . Oh, kiss a flaming goat if I know what I mean. I almost wish you didn't know the truth.
Did you have to choose this stable to be murdered in?
Luck is a horse to ride like any other.

Ilyena! My love, where are you?
Do you have any idea how long it takes to dig graves for twenty-three oak trees?
My name is Nynaeve ti al'Meara Mandragoran. The message I want sent is this. My husband rides from World's End toward Tarwin's Gap, toward Tarmon Gai'don. Will he ride alone?
Because each time we live, we get to love again.
Kneel and swear to the Lord Dragon,... or you will be knelt.

I forget nothing, Aes Sedai,… I said six could come, but I count nine. I said you would be on an equal footing with the Tower emissaries, and for bringing nine, you will be. They are on their knees, Aes Sedai. Kneel!
The Light shine on you, Lord Ingtar of House Shinowa, and may you shelter in the palm of the Creator's hand…. The last embrace of the mother welcome you home.

I am Lews Therin Telamon, the Dragon. I ruled these lands, unified, during the Age of Legends. I was leader of all the armies of the Light, I wore the Ring of Tamyrlin. I stood first among the Servants, highest of the Aes Sedai, and I could summon the Nine Rods of Dominion.
If you wish, you may call me Rand Sedai. I am, so far as I know, the only male Aes Sedai still alive who was properly raised but who never turned to the Shadow.
You wished to come in and dance with the Dragon Reborn, Cadsuane. I am what I need to be. Be comforted—you face the Forsaken, but have one as ancient as they at your side.
In wars, boy, fools kill other fools for foolish causes.
I would not mind you in my head,... if you were not so clearly mad.

We'll remember those who fell, and we'll tell our children how we stood when the clouds turned black and the world started to die. We'll tell them we stood shoulder to shoulder, and there was just no space for the Shadow to squeeze through.
You surrender when you’re dead. Many a man has been given less.
Dovie'andi se tovya sagain. It's time to toss the dice.
The nature of the world is that no man may know everything.
Being in charge isn't always about telling people what to do. Sometimes, it's about knowing when to step out of the way of people who know what they're doing.
I did not come here to win,… I came here to kill you.
What is too absurd to believe is believed because it is too absurd to be a lie.
We are always more afraid than we wish to be, but we can always be braver than we expect.
There is one rule, above all others, for being a man. Whatever comes, face it on your feet.
Asha’man, kill!
You are a coward and a tyrant. I'd name you Darkfriend as well, but I suspect that the Dark One would perhaps be embarrassed to associate with you.
Others go away. Narg stay. Narg smart.
But hope is like a piece of string when you’re drowning; it just isn’t enough to get you out by itself.
Small things were important. Seconds were small things, and if you heaped enough of those on top of one another, they became a man’s life.
I think the woman was born in Far Madding in a thunderstorm. She probably told the thunder to be quiet. It probably did.
Mother's milk in a cup!
Take life as it comes. Run when you have to, fight when you must, rest when you can.
Death rides on my shoulder,… Death walks in my footsteps. I am death.

Comadrin wrote, 'Attack on ground where your enemy believes you will not, from an unexpected direction at an unexpected time. Defend where your enemy believes you are not, and when he believes you will run. Surprise is the key to victory, and speed is the key to surprise. For the soldier, speed is life.'

The lion sword, the dedicated spear, she who sees beyond. Three on the boat, and he who is dead yet lives. The great battle done, but the world not done with battle. The land divided by the return, and the guardians balance the servants. The future teeters on the edge of a blade.

You can never know everything,… and part of what you know is always wrong. Perhaps even the most important part. A portion of wisdom lies in knowing that. A portion of courage lies in going on anyway.
If a sword had memory, it might be grateful to the forge fire, but never fond of it.
He has forgotten how to laugh except in bitterness; there are no tears left in him. Unless he finds laughter and tears again, the world faces disaster.
A general who draws his sword has put aside his baton and become a common soldier.
By the look of you, Nynaeve, I could almost think you were angry, but I know you have such a sweet disposition people ask you to dabble your fingers in their tea.
They will pay,… I am the Lord of the Morning.
Only a fool thinks his enemies stand still when he isn't looking, my Lord Dragon
I conquered before Hawkwing, though I needed no sword to do so. You are here on my land, Empress, at my sufferance!
My authority supersedes that of Hawkwing!
Mat,… are you really trying to get into a bragging contest with the Dragon Reborn?
The Black Tower protects,… Always.
When it is the Shadow that must be fought, our axes have always grown long handles.

Phaw!
